mechanism: Minocycline may increase infection risk in patients receiving vedolizumab (α4β7 integrin antagonist) due to additive immunosuppression, and minocycline carries risk of autoimmune hepatitis and drug-induced lupus which could complicate underlying inflammatory bowel disease.
action: Monitor for signs of infection and autoimmune complications; ensure appropriate infection prophylaxis and baseline hepatic/autoimmune screening; consider alternative antibiotics if clinically feasible.
